what: glystats: Statistical Analysis of Glycoproteomics and Glycomics Data — glystats-package
title: glystats: Statistical Analysis of Glycoproteomics and Glycomics Data — glystats-package
text: Provides unified toolbox bioinformatics analyses glycomics glycoproteomics data. Implemented methods include differential testing (t-test, Wilcoxon rank-sum test, ANOVA, Kruskal–Wallis), multivariate modeling visualization (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP), supervised learning (PLS-DA, OPLS-DA), clustering (k-means, hierarchical, consensus clustering), network analysis (weighted gene co-expression network analysis, WGCNA), survival modeling (Cox proportional hazards), enrichment analysis, correlation analysis, ROC/AUC evaluation. user-facing functions follow gly_*() naming convention facilitate auto-completion RStudio. package designed work seamlessly 'glyexp' tidy data workflows.
